pairs: For Mahalath: the thoughts of David.
The fool has said in his heart,
et abominabiles facti sunt in iniquitatibus;
and they became abominable with iniquities.
There is no one who does good.
Deus de cælo prospexit super filios hominum,
God gazed down from heaven on the sons of men,
to see if there were any who were considering
There is no one who does good;
Nonne scient omnes qui operantur iniquitatem,
Will they never learn: all those who work iniquity,
qui devorant plebem meam ut cibum panis?
who devour my people like a meal of bread?
They have not called upon God.
In that place, they have trembled in fear,
Quoniam Deus dissipavit ossa eorum qui hominibus placent: confusi sunt,
For God has scattered the bones of those who please men. They have been confounded,
Quis dabit ex Sion salutare Israël?
Who will grant from Zion the salvation of Israel?
cum converterit Deus captivitatem plebis suæ,
when God will convert the captivity of his people;
